candidate: Getworks container data centre at Nippon Paper's Kushiro works (日本製紙釧路事業所), 鳥取南2-1-47, Kushiro, Hokkaido
decision: Selected the coordinates of the single GSI address-search feature for Nippon Paper's published Kushiro works address (北海道釧路市鳥取南2-1-47), which GSI resolves to the block 鳥取南二丁目１番, as a campus_locator for the host property. The point marks the Nippon Paper Kushiro works property that the 5 November 2026 joint release names as the data-centre site; it is not the container data centre, a plot, a building, an entrance or a surveyed boundary.
coordinate_reference_system: Longitude/latitude as returned by the GSI address-search service (JGD2011 geographic, treated as WGS84-equivalent at this precision); used unchanged, no transformation or rounding.

selected_feature.title: 北海道釧路市鳥取南二丁目１番
selected_feature.resolution_level: block (街区); the house number 47 is not resolved by the service

identity_chain: The joint release of Getworks, Tokyo Gas Engineering Solutions and Nippon Paper, published on Nippon Paper's newsroom on 5 November 2026 (npg-news261105-kushiro-dc.html, sha256 1a7f4e71...14c0), says the three companies signed land-use and power-supply contracts for a container data-centre business at 日本製紙釧路事業所 (Nippon Paper's Kushiro works), with Nippon Paper providing the land (釧路事業所用地) and power from its existing generating and receiving plant there.

Nippon Paper's own office list (npg-about-sales.html, sha256 38269f89...d97861) and its Kushiro access page (npg-about-sales-kushiro.html, sha256 7396b0f5...1f) give 技術本部・エネルギー事業本部 釧路事業所 at 〒084-0905 北海道釧路市鳥取南2-1-47. These are the landlord's own published address records.

GSI's address search for 北海道釧路市鳥取南2-1-47 returns exactly one feature, 北海道釧路市鳥取南二丁目１番, at 144.357697, 43.009014 (block level). GSI's reverse geocoder returns Kushiro (municipality code 01206) and 鳥取南二丁目 for that point (gsi-revgeo-kushiro-point.json, sha256 38e13429...0a0a).

On GSI's standard map tiles (gsi-std-16-59047-24078.png, sha256 3bbb70ae...0145, which contains the point, and gsi-std-16-59047-24079.png, sha256 7e94daa5...c219, which carries the annotation) the point lies inside a large industrial property annotated 日本製紙工場, next to a factory symbol, which extends roughly between the trunk roads to the west and south-west and the riverside road along the Shin-Kushiro River to the east; it is roughly 0.9 km across (estimated from the tiles at about 1.75 m per pixel, not surveyed). GSI seamless aerial tiles (for example gsi-photo-16-59047-24078.jpg, sha256 f029d4bb...a8; undated) show the mill complex with chip yards and storage areas; the point falls in the northern yard and storage area of the premises.

The 2026 MOJ/AIGID public-coordinate registry-map file for Kushiro (moj-01206-2026.geojson, sha256 f0f174b0...fb12, 86,645 features) has no lots in any 鳥取 district, so no parcel outline is available and none is used.
extent_review: No data-centre plot, container row or building position inside the works is published. Container data-centre modules could be placed anywhere on the works land, so the data-centre position may be up to roughly 0.8 km from the point.
not_used: The Google Maps short link and embedded Google map on Nippon Paper's Kushiro access page were not opened, resolved or read for coordinates.
No commercial web map, PeeringDB or OpenStreetMap data was used.
uncertainty_reason: GSI publishes no positional accuracy for block-level address features, and the container data centre's position within the roughly 0.9 km Kushiro works is not published; the point marks the host property only.
tools: Distances and tile positions computed with Python (pyproj 3.7.1 for geodesics); tiles viewed as mosaics only for identity review, not for status.
